=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text data "54 26 93 17 77 31 44 55 20 -6 0 13 -21 93 8"
global vals long 16
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emiti writes a signed n; the magnitude is taken as a ulong so the minimum long cannot overflow
fn emiti n long to void
if lt n 0
emit minus
emitu add bitcast ulong not n 1
else
emitu ulong n
end
end
note parse reads the decimal numbers in s (separated by spaces, an optional - sign) into vals and
note returns how many; one pass over s, so the loop is bounded by len s
fn parse s view uchar * to ulong
n = ulong 0
v = long 0
sg = long 1
dig = false
for i ulong len s
c = get s i
if eq c 45
sg = long -1
else
if and ge c 48 le c 57
v = add mul v 10 long sub c 48
dig = true
else
if dig
put vals n mul sg v
n = add n 1
end
v = long 0
sg = long 1
dig = false
end
end
end
if dig
put vals n mul sg v
n = add n 1
end
ret n
end
note show writes vals[0..n-1] separated by spaces, then a newline
fn show n ulong to void
for i ulong n
if gt i 0
emit sp
end
emiti get vals i
end
emit nl
end
note shsort uses the gaps n/2, n/4, .. 1; each gap is a gapped insertion sort, whose inner walk moves
note down by gap at least once per pass, so 16 passes bound it; the gap halves, so 5 gaps suffice for 16
fn shsort n ulong to void
g = shr n 1
while gt g 0 bound 5
for x ulong sub n g
i = add x g
t = get vals i
j = i
while ge j g bound 16
if le get vals sub j g t
break
end
put vals j get vals sub j g
j = sub j g
end
put vals j t
end
g = shr g 1
end
end
fn main to int
n = parse data
show n
shsort n
show n
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
54 26 93 17 77 31 44 55 20 -6 0 13 -21 93 8
-21 -6 0 8 13 17 20 26 31 44 54 55 77 93 93
</pre>
